item.text: The Crime and Corruption Commission examined Queensland public sector corruption risks through complaints, investigations, intelligence and public information from July 2020 to June 2025.
item.support:
complaints received by the CCC relating to the Queensland public sector between 1 July 2020 and 
30 June 2025

item.text: It covered agencies within the CCC’s jurisdiction outside local government and the Queensland Police Service, including departments, boards, elected officials and other public bodies.
item.support:
all agencies within our jurisdiction 
which are not part of local government or the Queensland Police Service.

item.text: The CCC identified public interactions, confidential information and human resource management as high-risk activities and reported an increase in complaint numbers.
item.support:
Interacting with members of the public, managing confidential information and human resource 
management are high-risk activities for the public sector.

item.text: The CCC outlined prevention measures covering recruitment, induction, specialist training, recordkeeping, supervision, procurement oversight and workplace culture.
